show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: In The Great Desi Wedding, a celebration meant to unite two hearts turns into a storm of betrayal, vengeance, and buried secrets. When Radha’s honor is shattered by Meera’s jealousy and Arjun’s divided loyalties, love and tradition collide in a brutal test of truth. Amid rituals, revenge, and redemption, this “wedding” becomes a battle for dignity and justice.
